notes:
Summary: Watchpoint Vanguard runs national-level emergency contact centers supporting defense and critical infra. Primary ask: an on-prem, fully air-gapped Redwood deployment to power agent assist, live call summaries, automated ticket creation, and secure tool-calling into internal case management. Must operate without egress to public internet; everything audited.

Use-case details: agent_assist (real-time suggestion latency target: <250ms median end-to-end from audio->token->suggestion), ticket_summarization (post-call 2s-10s), tool_calling (must call internal ticketing + dispatch APIs inside air-gapped network via function-calling shim), reranking for high-signal intents, and quality_monitoring for red-teaming and regression detection. Expected baseline: 800 concurrent agents across 4 sites; peak spikes up to 5x during incidents.

Security & compliance: cannot accept model telemetry offsite. Requirement list includes SSO/SAML, ISO27001 evidence, SOC2-like controls, HSM-backed key storage, KMS integration with customer HSM, full audit_logging with immutable retention controls (7+ years), strict data_residency (site-local only). Procurement explicitly requested FedRAMP-equivalent documentation; legal will not sign without ATO-like letter.

Technical constraints: air-gapped appliance must include model catalog pinned offline, deterministic kernel selection, quantization profiles pre-approved, and an on-site model verification step. Network: strict VLAN zoning, separate management NICs, no external DNS resolution from appliance. Function/tool-calling must be proxied through a customer-provided adapter; Redwood must provide an SDK that runs entirely inside the air-gapped environment (agreement: no outbound callbacks).

POC plan & asks: 6-week POC: week 1 local install + network validation, week 2 model catalog sync & HSM test, week 3 agent_assist demo w/ red-team prompts, week 4 load test to simulated 5x spike, week 5 security review + audit logging verification, week 6 handoff + pricing finalization. POC deliverable: signed runbook, throughput/latency report, security checklist.

Commercial / pricing notes: highly cost-sensitive on TCO; procurement prefers annual committed appliance + per-token unit (hosted pricing not acceptable). Suggested starting estimate provided in drive deck; procurement wants TCO model with appliance amortization and worst-case spike capacity.

Quotes & highlights from calls: "We cannot have any telemetry leaving our network — even anonymized traces are a no-go." — Head of InfoSec. "Agent suggestions must not introduce additional cognitive load; low-latency AND high-precision is critical." — Contact Ops Director.

Next steps (short): deliver architecture diagram addressing HSM & network zoning (Riley), update POC SOW with FedRAMP-equivalent controls (Avery), confirm budget committee date, schedule on-site compliance review (Jordan to coordinate).

Open blockers: approval for physical appliance purchase, final legal language for on-prem support SLAs, demonstration of HSM integration, data destruction/retention test case.
